title: A source a refresh read by hand is dated through one factdiff command, not a scratch census log
goal: factdiff.py (or census.py) takes a source id and the fact lines a person or agent read on its current page and dates the source as confirmed, writing the same log row a census writes; found 2026-11-09 when a refresh run had to write a scratch census log and run census.py confirm to date 8 sources it had read by hand
